exposure: mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean section)
outcome: Neuronal injury biomarkers (phosphorylated axonal neurofilament heavy chain [pNF-H] and ubiquitin C-terminal hydrolase [UCHL1])
Brain oxygenation values (regional cerebral tissue oxygen saturation [CrSO2] and cerebral fractional tissue oxygen extraction [CFOE])
finding: There was no difference in neuronal injury markers or brain oxygenation values between term neonates born vaginally compared to those born by cesarean section.
mod_finding: The study found no difference in neuronal injury markers between term neonates born vaginally compared to those born by cesarean section.
